node.title: Re^2: PerlCon 2019 in Riga live streams
node.author: stevieb
node.doctext:
Although I'm not really a video person, I do appreciate having everything streamed like that, so thanks [Corion]! I'll probably take the time to check some of them out later.

What I really like are the photos you've posted. It was really nice seeing the faces of the collaborators of assistance and kindness here on Perlmonks.

Thanks a lot [haukex], and hopefully one day, I'll be able to meet up at such an event.

-stevieb
